rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a Day 5 expanded blastocyst/3BA, noting thinned zona and moderate ICM, but the image is suboptimal and the response may overstate TE continuity and absence of adverse features that are hard to confirm from this single blurred focal plane.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, prior live birth/failed cycle, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to age, morphology, and BMI; only minor overconfidence in image-based morphology and broad probability ranges.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer and avoiding overworkup after one failed transfer; minor speculative elements (e.g., sperm DNA fragmentation, dual trigger) are framed appropriately.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer management and sensible future-cycle planning, including SET, luteal support, activity guidance, review of trigger/maturity issues, and when to escalate evaluation.
